title: Recording, mixing: Born In A Prison by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Phil Spector

John Lennon and Yoko Ono recorded the Some Time In New York City song ‘Born In A Prison’ on 15 February 1972.

The recording was mostly completed during this session, and it was also mixed in mono. Strings were added on 18 March, and the final mix was created two days later.
